description: This file defines an asynchronous handler for form mutations in a routing forms system, including permission checks, form duplication, route and field management, and database interactions.

methods.name: formMutationHandler
methods.description: Main async function handling form mutation logic, including permission checks, duplication, route/field updates, and database upsert.

methods.name: getUpdatedRouterLinkedFields
methods.description: Enriches fields with latest router info, adding missing router fields, and updating existing ones.

methods.name: findFieldWithId
methods.description: Finds a field by ID within a list of fields.

methods.name: updateFieldsInConnectedForms
methods.description: Updates fields in connected forms based on the serialized form and input fields.

methods.name: getRoutesAndFieldsForDuplication
methods.description: Retrieves routes and fields from a source form for duplication, with permission checks.

methods.name: markMissingFieldsDeleted
methods.description: Marks fields missing in input as deleted, preserving columns for CSV generation.

methods.name: assertIfInvalidRouter
methods.description: Validates that a form used as a router is an origin form and not using other routers.
